diagram.title: How factorial of 3 returns 6
diagram.caption: Put each new call on top. Remove the top call when it returns, so the older calls finish in reverse order.

layers.label: 1. Push the frame for factorial of 3
2. Push the frame for factorial of 2
3. Push the base case for factorial of 1
4. Pop the frame for 1 and return 1
layers.detail: The answer for 1 goes back to 2.

layers.label: 5. Pop the frame for 2 and return 2
layers.detail: Two times one gives two. Send it back to 3.

layers.label: 6. Pop the frame for 3 and return 6
